segments.text:
\[
\text{数列极限}
\]
\[
x_{n} = 1 + \frac{(-1)^{n}}{n}, \quad \text{则数列} \quad \{x_{n}\} \text{收敛于 } 1.
\]
\[
|x_{n} - 1| = \left|1 + \frac{(-1)^{n}}{n} - 1\right| = \frac{1}{n}
\]
\[
\forall \varepsilon > 0, \quad \text{使得} \quad |x_{n} - 1| < \varepsilon \quad \Rightarrow \quad \frac{1}{n} < \varepsilon
\]
\[
N = \left[\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\right], \quad \text{则} \quad n > N, \quad \text{使得}
\]
\[
\left|1 + \frac{(-1)^{n}}{n} - 1\right| < \varepsilon
\]
\[
\lim_{n \to \infty} \left[1 + \frac{(-1)^{n}}{n}\right] = 1
\]
segments.speaker: teacher

segments.text:
\[
\text{数列收敛}
\]
\[
\text{若 } |q|<1, \text{ 则数列 } 1,q,\cdots,q^{n-1}\cdots\text{ 收敛于 } 0.
\]
\[
|x_n - 0| = |q^{n-1} - 0| = |q|^{n-1}
\]
\[
\forall \varepsilon \in (0,1), \quad |x_n - 0| < \varepsilon, \quad |q|^{n-1} < \varepsilon,
\]
\[
(n-1)\ln|q| < \ln\varepsilon, \quad n > 1 + \frac{\ln\varepsilon}{\ln|q|}.
\]
\[
\therefore, \quad N = \left\lceil 1 + \frac{\ln\varepsilon}{\ln|q|} \right\rceil, \quad n > N,
\]
\[
|x_n - 0| < \varepsilon \quad \therefore \lim_{n \to \infty} q^{n-1} = 0
\]
